scope.summary: Public-API semver baseline reproducible independent of registry yanks: scripts/oraclemcp_api_lock.sh builds the previous in-repo release tag from its committed lockfile (offline, locked), derives the release type from the planned version (CHANGELOG plans 0.12.0 vs v0.11.0 -> major for 0.x), and gates unreviewed API change via the committed public-API snapshots; api-lock CI job required (no continue-on-error, not PR-only). Commits d9eb2c09, bb24aac0, 7e2ba5ed, c9f20703 (earlier cb401f5a/c56a1aff).
out_of_scope: Proving every 0.12.0 API change is intended (bead no-claim); reviewed break list lives in CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased].

entry_points.name: head check (orchestrator re-execution)
entry_points.trace: Clean worktree at origin/main c9f20703, build lease: bash scripts/oraclemcp_api_lock.sh rc=0, baseline tag v0.11.0, 'oraclemcp-api-lock: OK - all locked public-API surfaces match their baselines.'

entry_points.name: selftest (orchestrator re-execution)
entry_points.trace: bash scripts/oraclemcp_api_lock.sh --selftest rc=0: semver_baseline_head_passes (v0.11.0, pass, checks_run 1012); semver_baseline_detects_planted_break (v0.11.0, expected snapshot-drift, actual fail-detected); semver_baseline_yanked_dependency_reproducible (v0.10.0 with yanked oracledb 0.9.1 via committed lockfile, pass).

entry_points.name: CI wiring (orchestrator check)
entry_points.trace: origin/main .github/workflows/ci.yml api-lock job: no if: filter, no continue-on-error; runs --selftest then the head check. 7e2ba5ed briefly made it advisory; c9f20703 (on top) removed that.

entry_points.name: compat check
entry_points.trace: Implementer-reported and consistent with code: ErrorClass/ReasonCategory serialize as SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE strings; audit failure fields stored as strings; only ora_code numeric - shifted discriminants do not break persisted records.

limitations: For the planned 0.x breaking release cargo-semver-checks evaluates 0 checks (253 skipped per crate); 'checks_run' counts enumerated checks, not evaluated ones. The effective gate for unreviewed API change is the committed public-API snapshot (planted removal detected as snapshot drift).
Orchestrator ruling (bead comment): 0.12.0 breaks vs v0.11.0 are the planned release changes.
follow_ups: Rename checks_run to checks_enumerated or add checks_evaluated so the metric cannot be read as evaluated checks.
